title: Practical Programming in Java
workloadNotes: Four programming projects (Project 1 solo, Projects 2-4 solo or with a partner) plus several quizzes outside lecture hours (lowest quiz grade dropped). Final grade based on weighted project and quiz scores; exact point distribution table in the source syllabus was not machine-readable. 3 late days total for the semester; early-submission bonus of up to 5% on Projects 2-4.
prerequisitesText: Some prior programming experience required; no prior Java experience needed.
